name: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce

pages.title: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
pages.text: $(thing)The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce$()$(br2)Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion.

$(thing)Insight$(): 200$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Compact Stars, Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Block of Neutronium.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Quantum geometry modifies the expansion of the universe near the Planck scale: the square of the Hubble rate is the classical 8πGρ/3 multiplied by a factor that vanishes when the density ρ reaches a critical density, and the curvature k of a closed universe adds its usual term. Write the corrected expansion rate.
